_readme: Japan Trip Guide — reference links. The guide reads this file from data/reference.json and falls back to the copy baked into the HTML when it can't be reached (opening the guide straight off your phone, or before this file exists). Add an entry by copying one of the objects below. 'url' can be an external link (https://...) or a file you put in the same data/ folder (data/whatever.html). 'kind' only changes the icon: pdf | page | sheet | map | link. Titles and descriptions take either a plain string or {"en": ..., "zh": ...}; a plain string is shown in both languages.

title.zh: [简报] 2026 ViTrox 公司奖励旅游

desc.en: The original slides from the 11 Aug 2026 briefing — itinerary, meals, activities, volunteer duties, money-changing service. The [TOUR] rows in this guide follow it.
desc.zh: 2026年8月11日简报会的原版投影片：行程、餐食、活动、志工任务、换钱服务。这份指南里的 [TOUR] 行程行以它为准。

title.en: CIMB TravelCurrency — ordering yen before you fly
title.zh: CIMB TravelCurrency — 出发前先订日元

desc.en: Screenshot walkthrough of the online order, the 4pm cut-off on 3 Oct, collection rules at Penang airport, whether the rate is any good, and how much yen to actually order.
desc.zh: 网上下单的图文步骤、3 日下午 4 点的截止时间、槟城机场取款规矩、汇率划不划算，以及到底该订多少日元。

title.en: Ginza → Narita hotel by Narita Express (N’EX)
title.zh: 银座 → 成田酒店：成田特快 N’EX

desc.en: Step-by-step with photos: finding the red N’EX signs, the zone B ticket machines, the 乘车券+特急券 rule, fares and receipts, how much Suica to load, and the hotel shuttle times for both possible hotels.
desc.zh: 图文分步：找红色 N’EX 标志、B 区售票机、乘车券+特急券的规则、票价和收据、Suica 要充多少，以及两家可能酒店的接驳巴士时刻表。

title.en: Tabung — how the shared money pool works

desc.en: Setting it up, recording contributions and spending, the “who shared this” tick boxes that keep it fair, reading the settle-up, and sharing it across phones.
desc.zh: 怎么开始、怎么记存入和支出、【谁一起分摊】怎么保证公平、最后的结算表怎么看，以及多台手机怎么共用。

title.en: Shared data files — user guide & samples
title.zh: 共享数据文件 — 使用说明与范例

desc.en: How the shared to-try list, tabung and tour data files work, what the status panel is telling you, and the sample files.
desc.zh: 共享的想试清单、Tabung 公款、行程数据这三个档案怎么运作，状态面板在说什么，以及范例档。
